verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a Status Pages product that gives real-time operational visibility, and says users can 'securely communicate' updates. That is only a glancing hint toward controlled audiences. Nothing in the evidence shows private or internal pages, or audience restrictions for customer-specific or employee-only viewers. Missing for 10: explicit private/internal status page support, access control or authentication for viewers, customer-specific audience segmentation, independent corroboration.
